works.title: Sinui Geimui Sin
works.synopsis: Myeong-In, a student at a third-rate university, doesn't get much support or respect at home. But his true identity is a professional online gamer who is famous and rich, a star gamer nicknamed "God of Game". Suddenly, three beauties intrude into his double-identity life. And Myeong-In learns a shocking truth from them: the elites of society play something called "Game of Gods". If you win, you receive superhuman abilities and powers, and you can basically rule the real world!

works.title: 5500 Shades of the Demon King
works.synopsis: A writer wrote steamy adult stories starring a Demon King. Now he wants justice! In order to avoid execution, the writer must make half the contents of her novel, a collection of lust and desire, come true! But wait, she is supposed to re-enact all the scenes, as the female lead, while the Demon King acts out the male lead???? Living in a world of demons, caught by its monarch and engaged in steamy role play! Let the games begin! (Source: POCKET COMICS)

works.title: Igye Museun Hwangbi
works.synopsis: A customer service worker Jin Ye-Rom has encountered a very troublesome customer, causing her number one employee status to disappear. Wanting her status back, she decides to find that customer and personally apologize to him, but, suddenly, she finds herself in a strange place. The next thing she knows, she's become the Empress, and that troublesome customer turns out to be none other than the Emperor himself!

works.title: What's Our Hero Doing?
works.synopsis: Hans wakes up as a minor character in Vantablack Ring, a game he's cleared countless times. To survive the monster attack, he decides to stick close to the hero, Kadith, only to see him immediately killed in battle. Shocked, Hans sets out to find the other heroes... but soon learns that the same fate awaits every one of them and that he seems to be absorbing their abilities. With his plans to lay low gone awry, will Hans have to become the hero and save this world himself? (Source: Tapas) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

works.title: UnderPrin
works.synopsis: Jin is a famous singer whose true identity is the legendary devil “Lord Perdien”. Even his son Miryu does not know that his father is the legendary devil. To protect his son, Jin fights. (Source: WEBTOONS)

works.title: Veteran of the Apocalypse
works.synopsis: When Seong-Ho logs off Survival Life for the final time, the last thing he expects is for the video game to become reality. Worse still, the game is set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies and deadly monsters. Having awakened as a hunter with the ability to open dimensional gates, Seong-Ho rushes to build a hideout in another realm in order to survive as he works to level up his skills and abilities, preparing to save the world from impending doom. But with other hunters emerging and forming parties, there may be more to worry about than just monsters… (Source: WEBTOON)

works.title: Master of Villains
works.synopsis: Mystic World--a virtual reality RPG game. Beopgyu Lee, the developer of Mystic World, wakes up to find himself in a strange lab which he recognizes as one of the settings from his game. To make matters worse, he is in the body of Han Lee, a notorious villain character. Find out how Beopgyu survives as Han in the game he created--not as the main character but as the master of villains! (Source: WEBTOONS)

works.title: Guardian Angel for Cursed Duke
works.synopsis: Astria leads a peaceful life as the keeper of the eternal haven. Until one day, a man on the brink of death shows up. The man turns out to be Duke Earhart, the most handsome and youngest swordmaster in the empire. Astria manages to save the dying Duke with her magic, But the healing magic is only maintained in close proximity… After listening to Earhart’s pleas, she decides to follow him into the human world. With her accidental introduction as a Duchess, Astria slowly adjusts to her new life. Will Astria be able to find true love and break the curse?! (Source: Pocket Comics)

works.title: The Iron Overlord of Sichuan
works.synopsis: Bearing the traitor’s brand, Se-un Tang spent a lifetime creating the tools of the Murim's destruction, waiting for a single moment to strike. But when the decisive moment comes, he is instead thrust back in time, carrying the weight of a future that hasn't happened. Let the furnace roar, let the hammer sing, and let their blood quench the steel. The Demon Smith stands before the anvil once more to forge a path tempered in vengeance. (Source: WEBTOON)

works.title: Himeul Sumgigo Jeulgineun Pyeonghwaroun Hanyeo Saenghwal
works.ar: 힘을 숨기고 즐기는 평화로운 하녀 생활
works.synopsis: Himeul Sumgigo Jeulgineun Pyeonghwaroun Hanyeo Saenghwal is available in the Lorefy Manhwa catalog.

works.title: Mollakan Myeonggaui Player
works.synopsis: Lee Yun, the youngest son of the Sermin family, a prominent house on the Dreia Continent. The once peaceful family descends into ruin after the disappearance of his father and brothers. And in the moment everything collapses, Lee Yun is captured by the Paton family and meets his end after horrific torture. But when he opened his eyes, he found himself not in reality, but in Adeon; an endless battlefield and playground of the gods. In that place where countless players lost their lives, Lee Yun grew into the Ghost King, a master player who mastered all classes: Assassin, Necromancer, and Ghost. He challenged the gods. He met his end in defeat, but his story did not end there. The moment he awoke again, he had returned to his childhood at age twelve, retaining the power of a player. To prevent his family's downfall and reclaim everything lost, Ri-yun now begins transforming reality into his own game board. His first target is bloody vengeance against the Paton family, another great clan that destroyed the Sermin family and killed him. (Source: KakaoPage, translated)

works.title: The Villainess's Princely Predicament
works.synopsis: Countess Edwith was destined to be executed for stealing Prince Linus' magical heart and selling it. That is, before I became the villainess herself! To avoid getting killed, I set off to search for the heart's whereabouts, only to end up stumbling upon a half-dead Linus! Getting involved with the heartless male lead is the last thing I want, but what can a girl do when her survival depends on it? Besides, it shouldn't be that hard to convince Linus that I'm not as evil as he thinks... right? (Source: Tapas)

works.title: Aileen's on Fire!
works.synopsis: After years of abuse at the hands of those who covet her title as heir to one of the seven great families, Aileen Spade discovers that the red eye she was shamed into hiding all her life is really the source of her family’s great magical power. Ready to reclaim her strength, she enters the magic academy, where she quickly becomes popular with her peers, the protagonist, and… the prince! But when she’s fated to become the story’s tragic villain, will popularity be enough to turn her life around? (Source: Tapas)

works.title: The Empress Wants To Avoid the Emperor
works.synopsis: When Louise realizes that all she’ll get in return for slaving away for an incompetent emperor is an early grave, she decides to ditch her role as empress, get a job within the palace, and finally earn a steady paycheck. However, her husband is ousted from the throne overnight and replaced with his long-lost brother, Regan. Just when Louise is about to celebrate her divorce, Regan announces that he’ll keep Louise as his empress. She tells Regan that she’d rather be his subordinate than his woman, but this new villainous employer tells her to be both! (Source: Tappytoon)

works.title: Seoneul Neomeun Yeonae
works.synopsis: Ara and Graham are childhood friends who used to have a sibling-like relationship. When they are finally placed in the same class (since the age of 8) as they enter their 2nd year of high school, their situation begins to change towards an unexpected direction. Will they be able to cross the line of dating, or not?

works.title: Trophy Husband
works.synopsis: Let me be your trophy. With her wealth, status, and godlike strength, Duke Serena has it all — everything but her heart, that is. Enter Ricardo, a charming prince who claims to know its whereabouts and proposes an alliance that would benefit them both. Is this mysterious suitor really the key to regaining her lost heart? (Source: Manta)

works.title: Jeoldaebokjong
works.synopsis: Da-Im, who was bullied by bullies chanced upon a game that was in his old phone that would change his life. An unbalanced strategy RPG game where one grows by ordering bullies to do things and recruiting kind people! The ultimate goal of this RPG game is to eliminate school violence from the world. (Source: Naver, translated)

works.title: Hujakga Daegongjaneun Murimin
works.synopsis: Hujakga Daegongjaneun Murimin is available in the Lorefy Manhwa catalog.

works.title: The Star Next Door
works.synopsis: Soo-Jung hates romance—she’d rather spend her nights fangirling in her room. When a noisy neighbor is tests her patience she goes upstairs ready to fight, but the last person she expected is the scandalous celebrity she's supposed to hate. Love and hate, different sides of the same coin. Which will win? (Source: Manta)

works.title: I Killed Him
works.synopsis: Attorney Kim Mooil usually only takes simple copyright cases to keep his practice afloat, so when his landlord comes to him and confesses to killing one of his tenants, Mooil thinks it'll be an open-and-shut case. But the day before they're to go to the police, his landlord seemingly takes his own life. As Mooil and his team of sleuths try to solve this mystery, he learns the incident may be linked to a police cover-up, revenge porn, and a murder from seven years ago. So much for open-and-shut! (Source: Tapas) Note: Includes three side story chapters.

works.title: My Beloved Baby Sister
works.synopsis: When Princess Fleta, who has been mistreated her entire life due to being born with a curse, summons the basilisk and destroys the palace, Princess Cezanne regrets that things could have turned out differently if someone had been by Fleta's side. So when she miraculously finds herself six years back in time, she is determined to take Fleta under her wing and fill her baby sister's life with nothing but joyful light. Will Cezanne be able to dispel the darkness inside Fleta and rewrite the ending? (Source: Tapas)

works.title: Love of Mine
works.synopsis: Hari is your average quiet girl who got assigned the bubbly Yeonju as a roommate, and somehow they became best friends. But just before Hari can tell her about her crush on a charming senior named Jinho, Yeonju says it first—and that they’re dating! After years of watching from the sidelines, Hari finally gets over him, but now he’s chasing after her... With no time for romance, Hari agrees to a blind date to get rid of Jinho. Who knew her blind date had an unrequited love of his own? (Source: Tapas)

works.title: Hoegwijado Mot Kkaen Tap Deungbanhamnida
works.synopsis: A friend who passed out while drinking suddenly said something strange. "Su-Hyeok, I've regressed." "Regressed?" "Yes, I've come back in time." "Are you crazy?" "You are the only hope for humanity." And then I was taken to the tower… But it doesn't matter! Regressor? Tower? Trials? Whatever it is, It doesn't matter but what I know is I'll conquer this goddamn tower! (Source: KakaoPage, translated)

works.title: Someone Like You
works.synopsis: When tragedy strikes and tears young Shinwoo's family apart, the charming Han swoops in like a prince and saves the timid boy with his kindness. So it comes as a huge shock to Shinwoo when his new friend and crush suddenly ghosts him after graduation. Initially, Shinwoo just thinks that Han got tired of him due to his fickle ways. But when the two reunite as adults, it turns out that Han has strangely little memory of their time together. As he slowly recalls their past, however, Han realizes that the quiet boy left a surprisingly deep impact on him in all sorts of unexpected ways. And because Shinwoo is very much his type, he's determined to do whatever it takes to win him over. There's just one unanswered mystery lingering in the air between them: why exactly did Han forget about Shinwoo in the first place? (Source: Tappytoon)

works.title: Resurrection Boy
works.synopsis: Unkillable. Unstoppable. Still hunted. Ji-O, a “Heart Mutant” with the Heart of Resurrection, escaped ten years of brutal experimentation, but freedom doesn’t last. With a body that can regenerate from any injury, he’s a target the world won’t ignore. The moment he finds something worth protecting, and even a sliver of a normal life, it’s threatened all over again by the very lab that tortured him and his friends. But this time, Ji-O is done running. (Source: WEBTOON)

works.title: Terrarium Adventure
works.synopsis: I'm a zillionaire in a gacha game! Obsessed with the clicker game Infinite Diamonds for over a year, Jae-Hee finally reaches the ultimate in-game achievement — only to suddenly find herself in the RPG gacha game Terrarium Adventure! Why was she pulled into the game, and how can she get out? For now, she has no choice but to explore! (Source: Manta, edited)

works.title: Marchioness Maron
works.synopsis: Once reviled as the wicked magician Hailey, the most hated woman in the realm, she was cast into a poisoned wasteland to die. But death never came. A year later, she’s alive and farming, bickering with a tree fairy, and somehow the new Marchioness Maron. As secrets of the contamination zone begin to surface and the ghosts of her past return, Hailey must decide whether to seek vengeance or build something new from ruins. When survival itself becomes the greatest twist of fate, who needs revenge? (Source: Tapas)

works.title: Creating Hidden Endings
works.synopsis: After beating "The Return of the D-Rank Hunter," the game, Seon-Woo wakes up as the game's NPC, kidnapped by the insomnia-ridden protagonist Jae-Hwi, who demands Seon-Woo become his Mentalist via a one-sided contract. To return to reality, Seon-Woo must unlock the game’s secret ending. Will he make it? (Source: Manta)

works.title: Jjajang Han Geureuse Jegalsega Derilsawi
works.synopsis: Do you think you can conquer the entire martial arts world with just one bowl of Jajangmyeon? The protagonist dreamed of becoming the best Chinese chef, but was sent to the Song Dynasty in China! However, when he woke up, there was no martial arts at all, and all that was left was the cooking skills he had learned in his previous life. But these dishes... the response is very good! In this life , will he be able to captivate Jungwon with Jjajangmyeon and live a successful second life? (Source: Naver, translated)

works.title: Mabeopsonyeo Ajeossi
works.synopsis: 202X. In the back alleys of Seoul, South Korea… He looked down at the heroes under his feet—the heroes who adorned themselves in a variety of colorful clothes, as if they were K-pop idols on TV. Those heroes? They were crawling beneath him, their gaudy outfits smeared with dirt. That was the true nature of being a hero. He hoped the individuals before him learned that lesson well. It was time to ensure they never forgot it. As a magical girl, he swung his hammer down. This is a bright story. The story of a man reclaiming his light. (Source: KakaoPage, translated)

works.title: Castle 2: Maninjisang
works.synopsis: Shin Kim is a special killer who gathered men from all over the country and made the organization "Baek-Yi" to destroy the absolute power "'Castle" of the underworld. Through a negotiation, he got inside Castle and started working with the enemy... Will Shin be able to take down Castle and complete his revenge as he hoped? (Source: Naver, translated) Note: Includes two extra chapters.

works.title: Dungeon-eul Geurineun Hwaga
works.synopsis: In a world forever changed by the Great Cataclysm that reshaped the entire globe... Seo Jio, an ordinary art teacher, dies in a sudden fire, only to awaken trapped inside a portrait as a painting himself. Within the world of the portrait, Jio gains omnipotent abilities. He can create life and even open gateways to other dimensions. As he travels across countless dimensions, Jio encounters people bound by fate and uses his newfound abilities to help them overcome the trials before them. But with every dimension he crosses and every incident he resolves, he draws closer to uncovering the truth shrouding his own death… (Source: Ridibooks, translated)

works.title: Born to be the Grand Duchess
works.synopsis: Annette Fraise was supposed to die as the novel’s wicked villainess. Instead, she’s using her 21st-century charm to survive her marriage to the cursed Grand Duke of the North, Loic Blenheim. Between one awkward accident, a magical curse, and a one-year marriage contract, love might just become the plot twist that changes everything. (Source: WEBTOON)

works.title: Return of the Namgung Clan's Granddaughter
works.synopsis: Because she was kidnapped and raised by the Blood Demon, Seolhwa destroyed the Namgung Clan, unaware that she was its lost child. When she learned the truth only after being killed by the master who used her, she awakens eight years in the past and returns home to try and change fate. But a dark spell and forbidden seals keep her from speaking the truth. Can Seolhwa change the future of her clan and prepare Namgung for what’s to come? Or will her family's blood spill once again? (Source: Tapas)

works.title: Heart Stain
works.synopsis: "Let's date until we graduate." U-Hyeon has a secret crush on his homeroom teacher. His best friend, Do-Ha, finds out and confesses his feelings for him. But then he makes an interesting proposition: "Go out with me. Fall for me before graduation, and I win. If you don't, you win." Can U-Hyeon like someone other than his teacher? (Source: Manta, edited) Note: Includes six extra chapters.

works.title: Lily the Vicious Villainess
works.synopsis: The Holy Empire of Serife’s saintess, Lily Stella. She was a holy existence that nobody dared to disrespect. But one day, she stopped hearing God’s voice, and the Holy Empire of Serife fell to ruin. Lily Stella, who was thrown into a well by the hands of the enemy, cursed the God of Serife whom she served all her life with all her might. “Serife. If you’re still listening to my voice, give me another opportunity. But if I die like this and return to your arms, I…” “I will tear you to pieces and eat you alive.” When she opened her eyes, wondering what happened, she had become Lily Stella of 17 years ago. She had returned as a 6-year-old child... She threw away her past life’s innocent self as the saintess. Deciding to become wicked, and to only live for herself (Source: Kakao, translated)

works.title: Four Dangerous Brothers to My Rescue!
works.synopsis: Warmhearted Lestia has resigned herself to a life of misery under the thumb of her abusive uncle. However, right when things seem to take a turn for the worst, a mysterious boy claiming to be one of her four long-lost brothers appears in the nick of time to save her. After being whisked into a life of luxury, Lestia has her doubts about taking on the Verchester name. But after the discovery of her latent magical powers, Lestia starts to accept two strange truths: She is a true Verchester, and she has a destiny to fulfill. (Source: Tapas)

works.title: Butterfly Love Effect
works.synopsis: Bullied at school and abused at home, Sul-Bi, a high school senior struggling with her interest in other girls and her dull life, is on the verge of ending it all. That is, until she runs into an odd girl, wandering the streets with no memory of who or where she is. Instantly falling for this mysterious girl who has no memories and doesn't feel any pain or hunger, Sul-Bi gives her a new name, Gu Seju, meaning "Savior". The only clue of Seju's identity is a mysterious note that appears in her pocket each day. Sul-Bi sticks with her, determined to help and solve the mystery that is Seju. However, as the mystery unfolds... Sul-Bi discovers a secret beyond anything she could imagine: Seju is her future girlfriend who has traveled back in time to see her??!!!! (Source: Pocket Comics)

works.title: The Crown I'll Claim
works.synopsis: "I wanted him so badly that I would have given up everything for him... And in the end, I did." After losing her crown, her children, and her life to the man she loved, Princess Medea finds herself back in her 17-year-old body. Now aware of the treacherous alliance between her ex-lover and her uncle, who have been scheming for the throne and fueling a rebellion, she's determined to save her kingdom and seize the reins of her future. Can the princess escape a tragic death and reclaim her destiny? (Source: Tapas)

works.title: Gwanjon Lee Gang-Jin
works.synopsis: Is he crazy? Or just the typical attention seeker? Lee Gang-Jin, who doesn't understand the differences between people, and his Master Kwak-No who's the one helping him to understand the differences between people. A warm human story of a student and his Master. (Source: KakaoPage, translated)

works.title: Bride of Elysion
works.synopsis: "Ina Yoo, an average girl from earth gets summoned to a fantasy world called Elysion where only males with magical powers exist and. Elysion summons females from other worlds and the men of Elysion treat the women with the utmost respect and try to charm the women to be selected as their husbands and mating partners. When the men of Elysion mate with the women, mana from the men are passed on to the women, and depending on the mana capacity of the person, the women can use this mana as their own power. Ina is courted by many men of the top hierarchy of Elysion population and her choice of husband affects her political powers in Elysion as well as magical powers. Ina is naturally able to receive much mana from the men, which is a great point of attraction for men, especially in positions of social power and influence. As Ina rises in social-political status with her increasing magical powers, a rival, Roxanne, appears and tries to overthrow Ina's influence in Elysion by creating riots. Ina now has to calm the riots but can she do so through her husbands and boyfriends...?" (Source: Pocket Comics)

works.title: The Forgotten Princess Just Wants Peace
works.synopsis: I'm the daughter of a Duke?! While locked up in a prison cell, Eluana Vita awakens her alchemy powers and later finds out she's the daughter of a Duke! However, she's in for a rude awakening when she realizes the royal life isn't what she thought it'd be. Join Eluana on her journey to find the peaceful life she's always wanted. (Source: Manta)

works.title: Haengbogeun Bitjarureul Tago
works.synopsis: Dan-Jo is a freshman in a university and lives a monotonous life. On orientation day she goes to the warehouse on an errand for her senior and witnesses a broom that transforms into a human. From that day on, the Broom Ghost persistently asks for help from Dan-Jo, who she has never met, saying she has nowhere to go. In the end, Dan-Jo accidentally gives the Broom Ghost, the name 'Eundohae', and they live together in a small gosiwon. In return the Broom Ghost promises to make Danjo happy. (Source: BOMTOON, translated)

works.title: Go Deok-Chun-ui Food Truck
works.synopsis: Jun-ho inherits his late Uncle Deok-chun's food truck. He travels the country, cooking to make the name "Go Deok-chun" known nationwide. Starting with Se-hee, the heir to a conglomerate, Jun-ho gets involved with women who each have their own stories in every region he visits! They all fall for him, but the one thing that truly captures Jun-ho's heart... is cooking! Follow the irresistible Jun-ho on his nationwide romantic food truck journey-business, let's begin! (Source: Naver, translated)

works.title: Jeoldaemusin
works.synopsis: On the verge of death, I was saved by a group of elderly demon – level existences at the apex of cultivation. But I, Yeon-gang had too much potential in martial arts, and alas was kidnapped and forced to become their disciple… Join me as I desperately try my best to escape their grasp, and enter the world of Murim!

works.title: Reading Club
works.synopsis: "For those who have courage…for those who do not fear death…open this book and turn the page!” goes the magazine in which this manhwa is serialized in. And for good reason. Peek into the horror within this particular book club. The president Kyungdo is a crazy maniac about books and while Eunsae tries to protect him from them, he is just so crazy about them. His fate in fact is connected to the legendary library of Alexandria, the greatest library that was ever destroyed, and Truman Capote’s In Cold Blood.

works.title: Maid To Love or Die
works.ar: 역하렘 게임 속 메이드는 퇴사하고 싶습니다
works.synopsis: After Irenea woke up as the chambermaid in a reverse harem game called "Love or Die," she thought she could get back home by seeing every good and bad game ending there could be. But she's still here! So this time, she wants to try leaving the Lavrenti family and the three young masters she serves, but they've all inexplicably fallen in love with her, even though she's just the game's "Save Point." So is the game now making Irenea the main character who has to choose who she loves and who dies? (Source: Tapas)

works.title: Gangnam Dokkaebi
works.synopsis: Someone has made a wish to kill all students. The Dokkaebis, man-eating creatures who are bound by rule that they can only act to help people, are now allowed to hunt down students... Students are going missing left and right and Ki-mok, a student who is also one of only 44 people in the world with the "Blood of Gold", is now in a fight for his life against these supernatural beings that vie for his blood to empower themselves.

works.title: Dusk Howler
works.synopsis: Kim Jee-Ha comes from a good background with decent grades and test results; however, he has one big flaw - when it comes to official events like university interviews for example, he is horrible. To overcome his social awkwardness, he embarks upon the virtual reality game Trikia where he meets an eccentric high level undead Nine - his future guild master. Source: Manga Updates

works.title: Itjanayo Yongnim!
works.synopsis: Though he had lost his family at a young age, through the help of Duchess Orleans and the Emperor, Karl grew up excellently. But at the banquet Karl attends to tell the Duchess of the Emperor's meaningful words, a questionable explosion takes place. Duchess, what is your true identity?! (Source: Boomtoon, translated)

works.title: Byeog Neomeo Yeonghwagwan
works.synopsis: The walls are thin, and it's hard not to know what your neighbor is up to, especially when they cry loudly every time they watch a movie.

works.title: GLEN
works.synopsis: Joseph lived an ordinary life and it all took a turn when he realized he was being stalked. First, his school, then his locker, his phone and eventually his home- every aspect of his life was infiltrated by his stalker. Joseph is at his wits' end when Glen, a stranger, steps into his life at just the right moment and offers him a helping hand.

works.title: My Second Life as an Idol
works.synopsis: From failed idol to hailed idol! Flop idol Yong-Min dies an unfortunate death but is given a second chance at life in the body of Ian, a super hot rich kid with a voice to match. At his side, he finds Jin, a mysterious soul tasked with guiding Ian to becoming a certified star. But is it really all smooth sailing from here? (Source: Manta)

works.title: The Grand Duke of the North
works.synopsis: Yumi, an actress with no experience in love, is terrified when she wakes up in a dark romance as Selene Belias on her wedding night! Yet instead of confining her like in the novel, her husband, "Monster Archduke" Varas, brings her gifts and takes her on outings. She falls for him... but then discovers he thinks she's a witch and is searching for the real Selene! Can this actress convince her first love that she's really his wife? Or is she to be cast out of this role that's not rightfully hers? (Source: Tapas)
